context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner direction defining better eventual action over increasing lifetimes as the hypothesis and research rather than infrastructure as the priority.
Project thesis, organ boundaries, measurement doctrine, and current claim limitations.
Experiment-to-claim ladder, required comparisons, planner attribution, capacity accounting, and on-policy distinction.
Unratified PCFL-Stream cohort design, bounded retrieval contract, capacity surface, and separate prospective-schema rung.
Upstream human-required J/P semantic-use DEV gate and its exact noncoverage of benchmark and paper claims.
Upstream human-required CPU interface receipt and explicit noncoverage of models, interaction, learning, scaling, and claims.
Mandatory deliberation, human-ratification, independent-review, and compute-authority contract.

strongest_case: PCFL-Stream can anchor one paper if it is presented as a deliberately synthetic, fixed-source causal benchmark of compiled per-life memory rather than as a naturalistic self-learning-agent benchmark. Its unusual strength is a matched repeated-measures design: independent causal information grows beyond the pinned model-visible window; the same world-life and target bytes are reused across memory systems; new acquisition, old retention, and old-new composition remain separate; an exact public sufficient statistic supplies a strong reference; and authentic/twin memory interventions can test whether later fixed-budget actions depend on life-specific bindings. A text-first gate can isolate compiler utility before LoRA expense, and a small same-corpus substrate-by-reader panel can then measure parametric transport without crediting candidate enumeration or clean-base composition to weights. This is paper-worthy as a benchmark-specific lifetime response surface if whole world-lives are held out, the independent unit is the world-life/twin pair, baseline-specific plateau is distinguished from superiority, and every information-bearing byte and unit of candidate/query/training work is accounted. The defensible headline is finite-range better PCFL action from target-blind compiled per-life memory, with separately attributed LoRA transport. PCFL-Schema, interactive evidence acquisition, generic graph discovery, universal SOTA saturation, and semantic compression should be cut from Paper 1 rather than added as more cells. A null or text-only result remains scientifically interpretable; neither this critique nor any upstream CPU/DEV artifact authorizes implementation, a model call, network or GPU use, confirmation, promotion, or a claim.

concerns.statement: Before PCFL-Stream can be selected as the single paper family, the exact headline must be narrowed to a fixed-source synthetic benchmark of compiled per-life memory and must delete generic self-learning-agent, broad SOTA, on-policy, external-validity, autonomous-discovery, and unbounded-lifetime language.
concerns.evidence: Both interpretations agree that independent nonce permutations, one common immutable source life, a frozen resolver, and no memory-caused future evidence distribution make the design internally clean but externally narrow. The owner's hypothesis is better eventual action where other systems saturate, not faster learning, yet the proposal's 'its own life' and amortized-agent wording can be read as the complete action--experience--memory flywheel. Resolve this by prewriting the benchmark-specific claim sentence, naming the compiler class accurately, naming only systems actually run, and treating broader agent superiority as a future hypothesis.

concerns.statement: Freeze one target-independent source behavior policy, public observation timing, randomization/propensities, failure semantics, and ExperienceEvent ownership before world generation; reuse its sealed chronology across arms and label the memory comparison fixed-source/off-policy.
concerns.evidence: If every arm gathers its own life, memory assignment changes the experience distribution and destroys the matched causal contrast. If one scripted or pre-assignment policy gathers the common life, the contrast is valid but does not test memory-directed exploration. The proposal does not choose between these cases or state whether target actions are batch-committed or may adapt to public within-item outcomes. Paper 1 should use the common source and one frozen primary target-execution state machine; any memory-caused evidence acquisition and durable recompilation must be deferred to a new material study.

concerns.statement: Seal a total no-rejection target/cohort/depth/age allocation before source support and compiler outputs exist, and retain every assigned unsupported, uncompiled, duplicate, generator-failed, and runtime-failed item in its predeclared denominator.
concerns.evidence: T01 forbids target-selected evidence but still counts only supported mappings, while the proposed text-to-LoRA edge says only a causally useful corpus may enter the LoRA arm. Selecting targets or individual corpora after observing support or compiler success removes pipeline failures and can manufacture acquisition, retention, composition, and transport. The generator may guarantee support opportunities prospectively, but realized introduced, supported, compiled, and action-usable coverage must be reported separately and may not control target inclusion.

concerns.statement: Replace the six-stage aggregate matrix with a descendant-level Cartesian visibility, taint, and reset contract that separates source prefix from evaluation goals and prevents hidden truth, allocation, support/compiler success, arm/capacity choice, and prior outcomes from entering any cognitive descendant.
concerns.evidence: PUBLIC_LIFETIME_PREFIX_AND_GOAL is marked visible to the compiler even though the compiler must not see evaluation goals, templates, proof/depth certificates, or allocation. Renderer, source policy, target allocator, support checker, canonicalizer, trainer, text index, candidate generator/ranker, prompt builder, conversation/cache, parser, action executor, monitor, and reset/suffix paths are absent. Filenames, order, length, ranks, omissions, retries, errors, latency, and caches can carry the forbidden values. Bind allowed inputs, output descendants, constant-shape behavior, and fresh-life reset for each component before implementation.

concerns.statement: Define depth as an independently certified graph-theoretic minimum over life-specific causal bindings, enumerate every lower-depth alternate proof, report environmental action depth separately, and require an eligible typed controller to achieve itemwise value one under the exact caps in every supported primary cell.
concerns.evidence: Depth can otherwise mean prompt steps, number of labels, or padded world actions and can covary with age, chance, anchors, and action horizon. Cross-era success over local atoms under a known grammar also does not prove that DREAM learned graph edges: the upstream J/P consensus states that full semantic facts with explicit graph edges removed can solve its semantic assay. Match target-visible marginals and Bayes headroom by depth; add full-facts-with-edges-deleted and exact public sufficient-statistic controls. Claim learned connection/graph necessity only if a predeclared edge intervention holding endpoint atoms fixed reduces action value; otherwise call the result resolver composition over local compiled atoms.

concerns.statement: Use an aggregate compiled-text causal screen only on disjoint calibration lives, freeze the compiler and the go/no-go rule, and if the stage proceeds install every assigned fresh confirmation corpus in both text and LoRA arms without per-life usefulness filtering.
concerns.evidence: Text-first staging is the right scientific and spending cut because LoRA cannot rescue a semantically useless corpus. However, the current edge's phrase 'only a causally useful ... corpus may enter the LoRA arm' permits post-treatment selection of successful corpora. That would compare LoRA on easy compiler successes and erase compiler coverage from the end-to-end estimand. A failed calibration screen may stop LoRA; a passed screen licenses only a separately authorized fresh-life transport stage, not selective corpus admission or automatic dispatch.

concerns.statement: Freeze a small substrate-by-reader panel containing matched candidate-assisted text and LoRA, candidate-only clean-base/no-adapter, wrong/twin-adapter, explicit text/index, and unaided generative-LoRA cells, with the candidate universe and every information-bearing external object bound.
concerns.evidence: Byte-identical corpus content removes writer selection but not differences in rendering, exposure, reader computation, candidate construction, or external storage. Recognition-assisted LoRA can be a reranker over a growing index that already contains the binding. Count canonical and training-view bytes, repetitions/order/negatives, adapter precision, index/embedding/candidate bytes, preprocessing, calls, FLOPs, prompt tokens, latency, caches, and failures. Use this panel at preregistered sentinel cells rather than crossing every reader with the full lifetime surface; claims must name the measured interface and cannot credit candidate cognition to weights.

concerns.statement: For LoRA credit, replace citation masking with predeclared paired substrate interventions: authentic versus target-byte-equivalent twin-trained adapters on all primary items, plus a small decisive-binding cut and matched sham-cut panel with common initialization, optimizer schedule, example order, exposure, and paired training seeds.
concerns.evidence: Deleting a cited external return leaves the association in distributed weights; citations may also be post-hoc or omit alternate paths. A feasible causal design need not retrain leave-one-out adapters for every atom. Train authentic and twin whole-life adapters from matched corpora and require the decisive action to move toward the twin-valid assignment; on a preregistered subset replace every occurrence and candidate/cache path for one environment-certified decisive binding while holding all nonintervened training bytes fixed, and compare with an equal-size nondecisive sham replacement. Report unconditional, authentic-success-conditioned, action-value, and cited-path effects. Without this evidence LoRA may receive transport correlation, not binding-causal action credit.

concerns.statement: For every baseline named as saturated, freeze its exact implementation and legitimate capacity policy, a pair-level equivalence-margin plateau rule over consecutive post-native increments, simultaneous uncertainty, and a resource frontier; test PCFL growth and endpoint superiority separately.
concerns.evidence: A baseline can be worse while still improving, and a shared artificial query or storage cap can force any external-memory method to flatten. Three post-native checkpoints provide only two increments and nonsignificance is not equivalence. The final number and placement of checkpoints must be chosen before confirmation from tokenizer-exact feasibility and pair-level power, with 2x/4x/8x only provisional anchors. Claims may name only exact full-surface baselines whose own intervals satisfy the frozen plateau rule; a superiority result without plateau must be reported as superiority only.

concerns.statement: Remove semantic-compression from PCFL-Stream's Paper-1 objectives; report compiled per-life parametric memory or a finite observed-range rate--distortion frontier unless exact serialized incremental bits plus all information-bearing external state grow sublinearly at predeclared noninferior action value.
concerns.evidence: Independent cohort permutations add linear fresh entropy and deliberately contain no reusable meta-law. Fixed rank may merely consume unused finite capacity, precision, a growing candidate index, optimizer/checkpoint state, or increasing training compute. Parameter count and a short empirical slope therefore do not establish compression or asymptotic sublinearity. Compare exact retained bits with the minimal sufficient statistic and atomic representations; reserve PCFL-Schema and any higher-order compression claim for a separate prospective change rather than letting it rescue this result.

concerns.statement: Before any model or GPU request, freeze disjoint whole world-life/twin-pair roots, pair counts from blinded variance or conservative power simulation, nested seed semantics, raw and normalized value, ordered superiority/noninferiority estimands, multiplicity, interval construction, and zero-versus-NOT_RUN failure handling.
concerns.evidence: Targets, checkpoints, depths, ages, twin sides, model calls, and training seeds are repeated observations inside a world-life pair and cannot increase the independent n. The four J/P pairs and its thresholds are DEV-only and cannot transfer. Primary confirmation must hold out complete lives, not targets inside inspected lives. Add one small preregistered generator-variant sentinel panel over renderer/template/schedule nuisance factors with the same causal quotient, or explicitly limit all claims to the frozen generator. Missing, duplicate, unsupported, malformed, timeout, compiler, training, and model outcomes must remain in assigned pair-level aggregation under a predeclared rule.

concerns.statement: Bind a calendar and compute envelope and replace the implied full Cartesian product with staged primary cells: CPU construct certification, disjoint compiled-text calibration, a sentinel LoRA reader/causal panel, then one locked full-lifetime confirmation over only the core arms.
concerns.evidence: Crossing every baseline, checkpoint, depth 1--4, age, capacity, reader, seed, twin, and leave-one-out cut multiplies training and evaluation beyond a credible single-paper schedule and invites outcome-dependent pruning. The minimum full-surface core should be no-memory/target-only reference, honest context then truncation, one strongest external-memory implementation selected by a frozen calibration tournament, exact public sufficient-statistic graph/program, direct-QA LoRA, compiled text, and compiled LoRA. Keep depths 1 and 4 balanced across the primary lifetime surface and use depths 2/3 as preregistered sparse diagnostics unless powered; lock one primary capacity plus a fixed-capacity reference, and place wider rank grids, other summary/RAG/linked-memory candidates, reader variants, generator robustness, and decisive-binding cuts only at sentinel cells. Cut PCFL-Schema, the on-policy/interactive loop, pointer-recursion diagnostics, full capacity grids, per-atom LoRA retraining, public benchmark packaging, and new containment engineering from this paper change. Missing cells and stage failures remain visible; no failed gate auto-promotes or repairs the next stage.

concerns.statement: Rewrite T06 so success is complete independent access, reproducibility, an explicit evidence-to-claim disposition, and preserved rejection authority; approve-narrow, null, NOT_RUN, and reject must all be valid terminal review outcomes.
concerns.evidence: The proposed expected result says the reviewer approves the supported rung, which pressures a nominally independent review toward a positive verdict and conflates process validity with scientific success. The reviewer must be able to reject the rung, approve only text, or confirm a null; an author-side advocate cannot override rejection, and repaired evidence needs fresh bound review. This critique and consensus can only reach human_required. They do not ratify design bytes or authorize implementation, models/providers, network, training, GPUs, confirmation, promotion, or claim release; the upstream human-required J/P and Bubblewrap consensuses also supply no inherited authority.

visibility_failures: PUBLIC_LIFETIME_PREFIX_AND_GOAL gives the target-blind compiler nominal visibility to evaluation-goal information that must be forbidden.
Target allocation can be influenced by realized source support or compiler success unless the total target manifest is sealed first.
Candidate content, index bytes, count, rank, order, omission, length, latency, retry, error, and cache state can encode the binding or reveal the substrate.

Proof/depth certificates, twin side, hidden optimal action, scorer output, resource receipts, and prior arm results lack descendant-level taint closure through trainer, prompt, parser, executor, and audit paths.
Per-life adapter, optimizer, index, candidate store, conversation, handle ledger, RNG, cache, and workspace resets are asserted but not bound component by component.

Calibration outputs can leak into confirmation through compiler repair, baseline selection, capacity/checkpoint changes, or target/template replacement unless only the frozen preregistered transition is permitted.
The model-facing visibility boundary for batch versus interactive target execution is unspecified and cannot inherit the upstream deterministic CPU receipt.
missing_acceptance_tests: PCFL_MAT01_FIXED_SOURCE_AND_PRESEALED_TARGETS: freeze the common source policy and observation timing, total target allocation before support/compiler outcomes, introduced-supported-compiled denominators, and all failure retention.

PCFL_MAT02_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_AND_RESET: split prefix from goals and exhaustively bind renderer, allocator, compiler, trainer, reader, candidate, prompt, parser, executor, scorer, audit, cache, and reset channels including derived metadata.

PCFL_MAT03_DEPTH_HEADROOM_AND_EDGE_NECESSITY: certify minimal causal-binding depth and all alternate proofs, typed itemwise headroom under caps, nuisance matching, graph-edge-deleted full facts, and edge intervention before any graph claim.

PCFL_MAT04_TEXT_GATE_AND_FRESH_CORPUS_INCLUSION: apply the text causal gate only to calibration, then prove that every preassigned fresh confirmation corpus enters all scheduled treatments without usefulness selection.

PCFL_MAT05_SUBSTRATE_READER_AND_LORA_CAUSAL_PANEL: run the sentinel candidate-assisted text/LoRA, candidate-only, wrong/twin-adapter, unaided-LoRA, decisive-cut, and sham-cut cells with paired seeds and complete information/resource ledgers.

PCFL_MAT06_PAIR_POWER_SPLIT_AND_GENERATOR_CONTRACT: freeze whole-life/twin-pair confirmation roots, generator-variant sentinel roots, pair-blocked estimators, power, multiplicity, margins, seed nesting, and zero-versus-NOT_RUN rules.

PCFL_MAT07_STAGED_PRIMARY_CELL_AND_RESOURCE_MANIFEST: bind core full-surface arms, sparse diagnostic cells, checkpoints, depths, capacities, stage stop rules, calendar, compute, storage, calls, and amortization denominator before outcomes.

PCFL_MAT08_REVIEW_OUTCOME_AND_CLAIM_SENTENCE_GATE: require independent reproducibility and an explicit approve-narrow/null/NOT_RUN/reject verdict mapped to prewritten finite-range claims without making approval a passing observation or granting authority.

Does Rohin approve the explicit Paper-1 cuts: PCFL-Schema/compression discovery, interactive evidence acquisition, pointer-recursion diagnostics, full Cartesian baseline/rank/reader/depth sweeps, per-atom LoRA retraining, public packaging, and new containment engineering?

Does Rohin want the proposed minimum primary surface--core full-lifetime arms, depths 1 and 4 primary with 2/3 sparse, one locked primary capacity plus a fixed-capacity reference, and reader/cut/generator diagnostics only at sentinel cells--or a different finite surface inside an explicit calendar and compute envelope?
Will Rohin require the compiler class and source behavior policy to be named exactly, with all targets presealed before support/compilation and the comparison explicitly fixed-source/off-policy?
Will Rohin require whole world-life/twin-pair confirmation plus one small generator-variant sentinel panel, accepting that omitting the latter restricts the paper claim to one frozen PCFL generator?

After adjudication, does Rohin confirm that exact human ratification and a separate bounded execution scope remain necessary, and that no current or upstream artifact authorizes implementation, model/provider/network use, training, GPU work, confirmation, promotion, or scientific claims?
